summary: When microphone audio feedback is unavailable (including while muted), Flutter now polls the full publisher peer-connection stats and falls back to currentRoundTripTime from the selected ICE candidate pair. Audio remote-inbound RTT retains priority; stale/unselected candidate pairs are ignored. A signed Android 1.0.7+11 release was built locally.

checks.name: Voice connection RTT report selection tests
checks.observation: Tests cover muted-microphone ICE RTT fallback, audio remote-inbound priority, ignoring unselected pairs and bounded conversion.

checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/voice_connection_quality_test.dart test/voice_connection_badge_test.dart test/workspace_screen_test.dart

checks.observation: No connected peer session was available to confirm that the device's selected ICE-pair report exposes currentRoundTripTime while both local microphone and playback are disabled.
